method: Embedded application JavaScript in Node VM with a minimal DOM stub. No layout or real browser APIs are verified.

checks.name: Embedded JavaScript parses and initializes defaults
100 rapid mixed actions match an independent oracle after every action
100 increments/100 decrements stay at bounds; all supported key variants
Entering 5 triggers one extra effect; decreasing/reset clears it
Text editing and modifier keys do not change the score
Control buttons clamp and disable; open/close and repeat-C behavior
Title, small label, color and reduced-motion configuration persist
Malformed saved data, null boot, arrays and out-of-range values are safe
Blocked storage leaves session controls functional and warning visible
System and explicit reduced-motion preferences suppress the effect
Accessible score and label update with state
OBS commands need explicit true opt-in, OBS runtime and non-preview mode
OBS commands share bounds, reset, persistence and reduced-motion logic without keyboard focus
Malformed OBS events cannot change state or configuration
OBS opt-in toggles immediately, persists and can be disabled
Lua companion payloads match HTML commands and only dispatch to the named fixed event
Portable export retains optional OBS listener and opt-in with a fresh independent instance
Portable export embeds current config/state with fresh ID and escaped text
Static offline audit: no external resource elements or network APIs; restrictive CSP
